name: customerId
label: Customer ID
help: Enter the 12-digit Observe customer ID from your Observe URL, for example the value before .observeinc.com.

name: datastreamToken
label: Datastream Token
help: Enter the Datastream token with write access to the target Observe Datastream.

name: makeApiBaseUrl
label: Make API Base URL
help: Optional. Required only to load and fetch Make custom scenario properties. Use your Make zone API base URL ending in /api/v2, without a trailing slash. Do not use the organization page URL.

name: makeOrganizationId
label: Make Organization ID
help: Optional. Used only when Make Custom Property Structure ID is empty. Enter the numeric organization ID from your Make organization URL.

name: makeCustomPropertyStructureId
label: Make Custom Property Structure ID
help: Optional but recommended when using Make custom properties. This is the ID used in /custom-property-structures/{id}/custom-property-structure-items. If filled, the app skips auto-discovery from Make Organization ID.

name: makeApiToken
label: Make API Token
help: Optional. Used to load and fetch Make custom scenario properties. Required token scopes: custom-property-structures:read and scenarios:read. Paste only the token value, without the word Token. Leave empty to skip this lookup.
